objective: Use a full-scale manual separating screen to recover dry ceramic finishing media into a receiver while retaining every representative steel washer, then return the released screen stably to both supports. This frozen rigid-PhysX specification incorporates causal recovery during loading; it is not a claim of full native qualification or demonstrated robot success.
instruction: Pour the dry mixture into the separating screen. Manipulate the screen to recover the ceramic media in the receiver while retaining every metal washer. Return the screen to both supports and release it.
industrial_mapping: Provisional category: Impact on jobs. Raytech records s-b442a7fa63fcb80c, s-a3efcebbecba0048, and s-855e796b5a3f8ecc establish manual screening as a real dry mass-finishing parts/media separation operation. The tested ability is controlled pouring, bimanual loaded-screen manipulation, aperture-mediated separation, physical bridge release, spill prevention, exact workpiece retention, supported replacement, and collision-free release. Historical PR684 and generic pouring tasks overlap with portions of the behavior, but the tested combination is not appearance-based sorting or ordinary pick-and-place. Occupational scale and final novelty remain uncertain pending submission-time review.
damage_rules: At reset freeze media set M as 24 single-body assemblies; washer assemblies WA as four assemblies; washer segments WS(a) as four rigid arc segments per washer; WS as their union; and collider-body sets S, R, U, C, G, and T for screen, receiver, supports, cup, robot/grippers, and table/floor. Count each washer once in admission and admitted mass.

Each washer has four authored breakable fixed joints with an assumed 200 N threshold. Diagnostic joint force is |J_constraint|/dt from post-solve constraint impulse with dt=1/240 s. Actual fracture latches only when PhysX reports a broken joint or formerly connected segments exceed the authored relative transform by 0.0005 m translation or 0.5 deg rotation. Reaching 200 N alone is not damage. Plastic deformation is not modeled or scored.

For every completed 240 Hz production interval: resolve physics; sample transforms, velocities, joints, signed distances, contacts, and impulses; convert impulse J to step-average force |J|/dt; advance transfer state machines; classify provenance and aperture passage; latch immutable faults and fracture; update containment, recovery, support, clearance, and dwell; then compute score. Process observation O_57600 before timeout. Control, rendering, and score reporting occur at 20 Hz from the latest completed physics state.

After two seconds of robot-stationary settling, measure an untouched three-second window of 720 completed physics intervals. Translation drift is max_k ||x_S(k)-x_S(start)||; rotation drift is the maximum quaternion geodesic angle; batch speed is max over M union WS and samples of ||v||. Reset every accumulator, transfer state, passage record, fault latch, fracture latch, eligibility flag, and dwell clock between trials.

Define signed penetration p(a,b,k)=max(0,-d_signed(a,b,k)), with negative signed distance denoting overlap. Screen-fixture penetration is the maximum over S versus R union U union T. Dynamic penetration is the maximum where at least one body is in M union WS and the other is in M union WS union S union R union C union T. Sample completed 240 Hz post-solve states.

Screen external contact force at a physics sample is the sum of magnitudes of post-solve contact impulses over manifold points having exactly one collider in S and the other in G union R union U union C union T union M union WS, divided by dt. Count each unordered collider pair once and exclude S-S contacts. This validates physics and does not grade the task.

Each intact assembly follows FEED→EXITED_FEED→FREE_FLIGHT→ENTERED_SCREEN. EXITED_FEED is an outward swept crossing of the cup-mouth plane through its clear opening. FREE_FLIGHT requires at least two consecutive completed physics samples after exit in which the full assembly is disjoint from cup and screen. ENTERED_SCREEN is a later inward swept crossing of the screen-rim plane through the open top. Intact washers require every segment collider to satisfy the transitions consistently.

A medium receives a persistent causal_passage_record only after valid admission followed by a genuine clear-aperture crossing. This record may be created before the last assembly is admitted. It is not erased by later completion of loading, but current recovery eligibility remains revocable if receiver containment or other physical prerequisites fail.

Direct robot contact with an individual medium or washer segment, a latched separate_stage event, receiver entry before genuine screening, non-mouth cup departure, inconsistent intact-washer segment crossing, or unauthorized segment separation before admission is invalid provenance and an immutable zero-score fault. Mixture-to-mixture and incidental cup-rim or sub-0.05-second external contacts are allowed. An actual authored-joint break after admission is fracture instead.

full_inside_screen(b,k) is true only when every transformed vertex of every convex collider belonging to b lies in or on the frozen closed screen-containment volume and no collider intersects the open-top escape plane outside the inner rim. For fractured washers it applies to every fragment. over_rim_exit is a swept transition from full_inside_screen to outside where any swept collider vertex or edge intersects the top plane outside the inner-rim disk.

A genuine aperture crossing is a downward swept-volume crossing through screen-floor z=0 whose plane intersection lies strictly within exactly one frozen aperture polygon and whose swept collider has nonnegative signed distance from every rib. Center-only passage does not qualify. Crossings outside an aperture or through a rib are spill or tunneling events, not recovery.

Washer loss latches when any segment or fragment exits over the rim after admission, contacts T outside R, becomes inaccessible, or crosses below the screen floor without a genuine aperture path. Media spill latches when a medium exits over the rim, contacts T outside R, enters R without causal valid admission and genuine aperture passage, exits R after entry, crosses the floor outside an aperture, becomes inaccessible, or intersects a receiver wall. Re-entry never erases a latch.

Receiver contamination latches when any washer, fragment, or other non-media task collider overlaps the receiver interior. Washer loss, media spill, receiver contamination, invalid provenance, and forbidden state mutation are permanent zero-score failures. Actual washer fracture alone permanently caps score at 0.40 only while every fragment remains retained and no independent hard failure occurs.

Use tabletop coordinates and closed workspace P={-0.55<=x<=0.55,-0.05<=y<=0.75,-0.02<=z<=0.75} m. A body is inaccessible if any collider vertex leaves P, any collider point falls below z=-0.02 m, or its full collider lies in a closed fixture volume while all four frozen 0.08 m by 0.08 m by 0.20 m approach prisms along +z,-x,+x,-y intersect non-target collision meshes. IK failure alone is not inaccessibility.

Any post-reset pose or velocity write to M union WS union S union R union U union C, fake grasp weld, required-collider disablement, particle freezing, hidden restoring force, task-object teleport, or unlogged physics substitution is a forbidden-state-mutation hard failure. Breakage, spill, loss, excessive contact, and escape must remain physically possible.

Define external staging set X as table/floor colliders T excluding colliders belonging to C, S, R, or U and excluding their frozen vertical projections. separate_stage(b) latches only if, after EXITED_FEED and before ENTERED_SCREEN, the full assembly is outside C and S, has resolved support contact with X for 12 consecutive completed physics intervals, has maximum linear speed <=0.02 m/s over those intervals, and is not simultaneously supported by C or S. A swept incidental touch, bounce, or contact shorter than 0.05 s is not staging.

All component trials use screen frame F_s with origin at the tested aperture center, +z normal to the locked floor, +x and +y parallel to aperture edges, gravity (0,0,-9.81) m/s², production contacts, dt=1/240 s, a fresh reset, and zeroed accumulators. Unless specified otherwise, observation lasts 720 completed intervals. Media starts at zero velocity with its lowest point 0.00001 m above first contact. End-first trials set the media axis to +z and use R=R_z(yaw); transverse trials set it to +x using R=R_z(yaw)R_y(pi/2). In both, yaw is {0,45,90,135} degrees and COM x-y offset is {(0,0),(0.001,0),(-0.001,0),(0,0.001),(0,-0.001)} m. Pass means the whole collider completes a genuine downward aperture crossing by interval 720 without rib tunneling. A transverse trial is bridged when it has no genuine crossing, remains in screen contact with COM above z=0, and has maximum speed below 0.005 m/s for the final 60 intervals. Recreate each bridged seed, then drive screen roll about the F_s +x axis through its floor-center pivot as 5 degrees*sin(4*pi*t) for 2.0 s and observe another 1.0 s. Release means a genuine crossing; releases/bridged trials is the rate, and zero bridged trials explicitly fails with reported rate 0.

Washer escape qualification uses the same F_s and one central complete aperture. The intact washer reference pose has center (0,0,z_c), ring normal +z, zero velocity, and z_c chosen so the lowest outer-ring collider point is 0.00001 m above first floor/rib contact. For each tilt alpha in {0,30,60,90,120,150,180,210,240,270} degrees and yaw beta in {0,90,180,270} degrees, apply the extrinsic screen-frame rotation R=R_z(beta)R_x(alpha) to the complete washer about its center, then recompute only z_c from the stated clearance; x=y remain exactly zero. No additional roll, translation, support, or initial contact is permitted. Escape is any segment completing a downward floor crossing through or outside the aperture within 720 intervals. Rate is escaped trials/40 and all transforms, rotation order, and trial outcomes must be logged.

Bore-lodging qualification uses a diagnostic carrier frame F_c initially coincident with F_s and located away from every aperture and screen collider. The intact washer center is at F_c origin, its ring plane is x-y, bore normal is +z, and its bottom face is z=-0.002 m. Four collision-enabled 0.004 by 0.004 by 0.001 m support pads are rigidly attached to the carrier, pad centers are (0.012,0,-0.0025), (-0.012,0,-0.0025), (0,0.012,-0.0025), and (0,-0.012,-0.0025) m, and no pad or carrier collider enters radial distance 0.006 m from the bore axis. A diagnostic fixed joint holds the intact washer center and orientation to F_c; its impulses are logged and excluded from production scoring. The carrier is connected to world by an authored revolute joint whose axis is F_c +x through the washer center. A medium starts with its body axis +z, zero velocity, its lower nose 0.00001 m above the washer top bore plane z=0.002 m, yaw {0,45,90,135} degrees, and x-y offset {(0,0),(0.0005,0),(-0.0005,0),(0,0.0005),(0,-0.0005)} m. Hold the carrier at zero angle for 1.0 s, rotate it monotonically by pi radians about +x using theta(t)=pi*(t-1.0)/0.5 for 1.0<=t<=1.5 s, then hold theta=pi for 1.5 s. All pad, washer, and medium collisions remain enabled. Lodged means medium-washer contact persists for the final 60 intervals, the medium has no contact or joint with pads, carrier, screen, or other colliders, and its COM remains within 0.015 m of the washer center. Rate is lodged trials/20; reset the complete carrier, joint, washer, and medium state between trials.
assets: Independently authored full-scale separating screen with sourced outer diameter 0.3683 m and depth 0.0635 m; assumed 0.003 m floor/wall thickness, 0.150 m perforated-floor radius, 0.0127 m square clear apertures, 0.003 m ribs, 0.0157 m pitch, 0.40 kg mass, and two 0.040 by 0.018 by 0.005 m grasp tabs.

Screen coordinates use floor center as origin and +z upward. Inner radius is 0.18115 m from z=0 to 0.0605 m; outer radius is 0.18415 m and rim plane z=0.0635 m. Include a complete axis-aligned aperture only when all four corners lie within radius 0.150 m; discard rather than clip boundary apertures. Preserve finite openings instead of using a convex hull that fills them.

Twenty-four free rigid ceramic angle-cut bodies with sourced diameter 0.009525 m and axial envelope 0.022225 m; assumed parallel 15 degree cuts and density 2500 kg/m³. Ideal circular-section reference mass is 0.003504496907 kg. The frozen 32-sided watertight mesh has volume 1.3928088187296442e-6 m³ and authored mass 0.0034820220468 kg. Author COM and inertia from that mesh and density and compare native readback.

Four representative steel washer assemblies: 0.030 m outer diameter, 0.008 m bore, 0.004 m thickness, density 7850 kg/m³, four rigid arc segments, and four authored breakable fixed joints. Analytic summed mass is 0.0206170159 kg each. No commercial SKU is claimed.

Rigid receiver outer dimensions 0.45 by 0.40 by 0.08 m with 0.005 m floor/walls; strict open interior -0.220<x<0.220, -0.195<y<0.195, 0.005<z<0.075 m in receiver coordinates. Two support beams are each 0.52 by 0.015 by 0.010 m. Feed cup outer diameter is 0.078 m, height 0.100 m, wall/floor thickness 0.003 m, and empty mass 0.10 kg.

Pinned public YAM asset and guarded 14D left-seven/right-seven joint-action interface. The pinned scene fixes production dt=1/240 s and accepts 20 Hz control, yielding 12 completed physics intervals per action; prospective refinement uses dt=1/480 s.
Industrial sources: Raytech records s-b442a7fa63fcb80c, s-a3efcebbecba0048, and s-855e796b5a3f8ecc; occupational-context record s-474cfcd0ccaa5ecb.
approximations: Only dry rigid-body separation is modeled. Polishing, abrasion, liquid, wet cohesion, dust, wear, lubrication, plastic deformation, and material-property changes are excluded.
The historical selected candidate remains planning evidence, but its permanent-deformation phrase is superseded: only actual authored-joint washer fracture can impose the 0.40 damage cap.

Recovery is recorded per medium after its own valid FEED→EXITED_FEED→multi-sample FREE_FLIGHT→ENTERED_SCREEN→genuine aperture path, even if passage occurs before final batch admission. Complete loading therefore does not require all 28 assemblies to be simultaneously inside the screen.

Aperture layout, ribs, wall profile, screen mass, grasp tabs, media cuts and density, fixtures, representative washer geometry, four-segment fracture proxy, 200 N threshold, and diagnostic qualification fixtures are disclosed engineering assumptions rather than manufacturer CAD or calibrated commercial specifications.

Initial uncalibrated contacts are ceramic/polymer static/dynamic friction 0.50/0.35, steel/polymer 0.45/0.35, media/media 0.40/0.30, restitution 0.05, contact offset 0.00015 m, rest offset 0 m, and 32/8 solver position/velocity iterations. They require native qualification and may not be tuned using hidden forces, collider removal, freezing, or suppressive velocity caps.

The existing 240 Hz aperture probe and mesh mass/inertia readback are narrow component evidence only. Washer retention, bridge release, bore lodging, complete screen/receiver/support physics, robot manipulation, scoring controls, paired refinement, and fresh-process full demonstrations remain unverified.
Joint margins cover every controlled non-fixed robot joint at every 240 Hz sample from the first guarded action through final clearance. Lower margin is q-q_lower and upper margin is q_upper-q.

Camera checks use rendered 20 Hz frames. Valid RGB pixels are finite and in encoded range; valid depth pixels are finite and positive. Visibility requires at least one unoccluded projected pixel for the screen, cup, receiver, one complete medium, and one complete washer, with no identifying overlays.

Refinement replays identical seeds, resets, transforms, action timestamps, and held 20 Hz actions at 240 and 480 Hz for seeds 0 through 4. Reset all states and latches between trials. Recovery delta is the maximum paired absolute final-r difference; event delta is the maximum paired difference in distinct immutable event types.

Scripted experts may read poses, velocities, joints, contacts, and scorer flags to plan normal guarded actions. Oracle reads do not alter model observations and never authorize state writes, teleports, fake welds, collision disablement, freezing, or hidden forces.

The washer-escape and bore-lodging qualification transforms, support geometry, contact locations, rotation order, and joint axes are frozen explicitly to make their rates reproducible; diagnostic carrier joints are excluded from production task scoring and cannot appear in a robot demonstration.
scoring_spec: At reset freeze M, WA, WS(a), masses, collider sets, containment geometry, aperture polygons, workspace P, fixture meshes, and approach corridors. Let M0=sum_{i in M}m_i+sum_{a in WA}m_a and MM0=sum_{i in M}m_i. valid_admission(b)=1 only after b completes FEED→EXITED_FEED→FREE_FLIGHT→ENTERED_SCREEN without a provenance fault. admitted_mass=sum_{i in M}m_i*valid_admission(i)+sum_{a in WA}m_a*valid_admission(a), and F=clamp(admitted_mass/M0,0,1). causal_passage(i)=1 persistently after medium i has valid admission and subsequently completes a genuine clear-aperture crossing; it may become true before all other assemblies are admitted. complete_loading is true iff all 28 original assemblies have valid admission, every washer segment or fracture fragment is currently full_inside_screen, and every admitted medium is currently either full_inside_screen or causally passed and strictly receiver-contained. eligible_receiver(i,k)=1 iff causal_passage(i)=1, i is currently strictly inside the receiver interior, and i has never spilled, become inaccessible, intersected a receiver wall, or incurred invalid provenance. Define r=clamp(sum_{i in M}m_i*eligible_receiver(i,k)/MM0,0,1). Eligibility is recomputed and revocable at every physics sample. washer_retained requires every current washer segment or fragment collider to be full_inside_screen; an unfractured washer also requires every authored joint intact. supported requires resolved S-U contact on both beams, lowest screen geometry within 0.002 m of support-top z=0.13 m, |roll|<=3 degrees, |pitch|<=3 degrees, and screen-center projection x in [-0.26,0.26] m and y in [0.15,0.35] m. clear requires minimum signed distance from every G collider to S union M union WS/fragments >=0.060 m. clean means no hard failure. Q=1 iff complete_loading, F=1, r>=0.98, washer_retained, supported, clear, and clean. Dwell begins at k0 when Q first becomes true; that sample contributes zero elapsed time. D=1 only when Q remains true through k-k0>=720 consecutive completed 240 Hz intervals. Any false prerequisite resets k0 and revokes D. Base score B=0.20F+0.70*clamp(r/0.98,0,1)+0.10D. Final score is 0 after any immutable hard failure; otherwise min(B,0.40) after actual washer fracture and B without fracture. Report at 20 Hz using the latest completed physics sample and process O_57600 before timeout. Untouched score is 0; complete loading with no recovery is 0.20; 12 of 24 equal-mass eligible media gives 0.5571428571; threshold recovery without dwell gives 0.90; intact valid released dwell gives 1.00. Hand identity, action count, shake count, and prescribed order are not graded.

required_controls.name: untouched_reset_zero_score_control
required_controls.reason: No assembly has valid admission, so F=r=D=0.

required_controls.name: valid_complete_loading_no_recovery_control
required_controls.reason: All 28 assemblies are validly admitted, all washers and media remain in the screen, F=1, r=0, and D=0.

required_controls.name: physical_half_media_recovery_control
required_controls.reason: Complete loading holds and exactly 12 of 24 equal-mass media are eligible: 0.20+0.70*(0.50/0.98).

required_controls.name: valid_threshold_recovery_unreleased_control
required_controls.reason: F=1 and r>=0.98 while D=0.

required_controls.name: valid_released_supported_dwell_control
required_controls.reason: All intact prerequisites remain true for 720 completed 240 Hz intervals.

required_controls.name: timeout_exact_720_interval_dwell_control
required_controls.reason: Q true from O_56880 through processed O_57600 spans exactly 720/240 seconds.

required_controls.name: timeout_719_interval_dwell_control
required_controls.reason: Q true from O_56881 through O_57600 spans only 719/240 seconds.

required_controls.name: cup_exit_multisample_flight_entry_control
required_controls.reason: Every assembly completes causal admission with at least two free-flight samples and no medium is recovered.

required_controls.name: early_legitimate_passage_then_complete_loading_control
required_controls.reason: At least 98% of media validly enter and genuinely cross apertures before the last washer is admitted; after all admissions those media remain receiver-contained.

required_controls.name: early_passage_receiver_exit_revocation_control
required_controls.reason: A causally passed medium later exits the receiver, latching immutable spill.

required_controls.name: post_cup_empty_aperture_recovery_control
required_controls.reason: Genuine crossings after the cup empties remain eligible and yield F=1, r>=0.98, D=0.

required_controls.name: postadmission_retained_fracture_cap_control
required_controls.reason: Actual authored-joint fracture with every fragment retained and no independent fault caps an otherwise full result.

required_controls.name: diagnostic_force_without_break_control
required_controls.reason: A 200 N diagnostic reading without a reported break or relative-transform failure does not alter F=1, r>=0.98, D=0.

required_controls.name: direct_cup_receiver_shortcut_failure_control
required_controls.reason: Receiver entry without valid screen admission and genuine aperture passage invalidates provenance.

required_controls.name: separately_staged_washer_failure_control
required_controls.reason: A washer satisfies the frozen 12-interval separate_stage predicate on X before screen entry.

required_controls.name: individual_media_robot_contact_failure_control
required_controls.reason: Direct individual-medium manipulation invalidates provenance.

required_controls.name: single_media_over_rim_spill_failure_control
required_controls.reason: One immutable off-path spill overrides all progress.

required_controls.name: all_media_spilled_after_loading_failure_control
required_controls.reason: Historical admission and passage records are overridden by the first spill.

required_controls.name: partial_washer_rim_escape_failure_control
required_controls.reason: A fragment or segment partially crossing outside the rim is washer loss even if its center remains inside.

required_controls.name: washer_inaccessibility_failure_control
required_controls.reason: Inaccessibility of any washer segment or fragment is washer loss.

required_controls.name: fracture_fragment_loss_failure_control
required_controls.reason: Fracture followed by fragment loss invokes the independent washer-loss hard failure.

required_controls.name: receiver_contamination_failure_control
required_controls.reason: Any non-media task collider overlapping receiver interior permanently overrides score.

required_controls.name: receiver_exit_media_spill_failure_control
required_controls.reason: A recovered medium exiting the receiver latches spill.

required_controls.name: post_success_clearance_revocation_control
required_controls.reason: Breaking 0.060 m clearance resets Q and D while valid loading and recovery remain.

required_controls.name: post_success_support_revocation_control
required_controls.reason: Losing two-beam support resets Q and D while valid loading and recovery remain.

required_controls.name: forbidden_state_mutation_failure_control
required_controls.reason: A state write, teleport, fake weld, collider disablement, freeze, hidden force, or equivalent mutation invokes permanent failure.
